references.text: God warned the Israelites against taking Canaanite daughters as wives for their sons, because it would lead to idolatry.
Moses forbade marriage with the Canaanite peoples and warned that this would lead to apostasy from the Lord.
Joshua warned the Israelites against marrying the remaining peoples, saying that this would become a snare to them.
Solomon married foreign women who turned his heart away from the Lord to other gods, just as the warning in Judges stated.
Ezra describes how the Israelites had not separated themselves from the abominations of the surrounding peoples and had taken their daughters as wives.
Nehemiah rebuked the Jews for marrying foreign women and pointed to Solomon's sin as a result of such marriages.
The Israelites were warned against making covenants with the Canaanites or their gods, because this would become a snare to them.
